blocks.text: A quick housekeeping note before the long weekend. I am closing out the June timesheets this afternoon, and two are still open. The names on my list are Michael Morris and Kimberly Le, so this is just a nudge, not a fire drill.

If you can log your June hours by the end of the day, I will have the month reconciled and off my desk before we break. There is nothing to reformat or attach; the standard entry is fine. Send it however is easiest for you, and I will handle the reconciliation from there.
